source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Board A of the Singles Event Companion is for Take and Hold against Priority Assets. The Take and Hold player plays Inescapable Dominion and the Priority Assets player plays Secure Asset. The app pairs this board with the Crucible Of Battle deployment. Neither disposition fixes the Attacker or Defender role; a roll-off settles that. Every zone, territory, objective and terrain position comes only from the official board image, and this entry states no measurements. Its lettered terrain pieces refer to the parts of the Battlefields: Armageddon kit.
